name: kr-humanizer
description: Graph-guided Korean drafting, Spark sentence completion, and explicit review

interface.longDescription: Plan Korean writing as editable context nodes, continue a draft with opt-in Codex Spark sentence suggestions, retrieve relevant National Institute of Korean Language guidance, compare rewrites sentence by sentence, and accept only chosen changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use KR-humanizer to review this Korean text and show every proposed change before applying it.
